final_text:
Dear Elena,

Thank you for your message, and we look forward to welcoming you on Friday 6 November.

1. Dogs: Biscuit is welcome. Dogs up to 40 lbs are allowed, with a maximum of two dogs per room. The pet fee is $75 per stay and is non-refundable [P1]. Dogs are not permitted at the pool or in the restaurant [P1].

2. Late check-out: As a Gold member, you are entitled to check-out until 2:00 PM, subject to availability [P8]. Weekend late check-out is capped at 12:00 PM [P7], but Monday is not a weekend day. We have noted your request, and the team will confirm.

3. Airport pickup from MIA: We can arrange this. A sedan (up to 3 guests) is $65 one way, and an SUV (up to 6 guests) is $95 one way. Transfers must be booked at least 24 hours in advance [P9]. We have sent your request to our reservations team, who will confirm the vehicle, price and pickup time with you. We do not offer transfers from Fort Lauderdale.

A manager will not need to review these requests, but the team will confirm the details shortly.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your email. We're looking forward to welcoming you and your dogs on 13 November.

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. For your 3 nights, that comes to $50 per night, and the team will confirm the total.

Early check-in: Our standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and can't be guaranteed in advance [P6]. We've passed your request for around noon to our front desk, who will confirm whether early check-in is possible and any fee.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way and runs hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Bookings must be made at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. We've sent your request for three passengers arriving around 11:00 AM. Please confirm your flight number and landing time, and our team will confirm the booking.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Gracias por escribirnos. Sobre su reserva ML-2021 (Standard Queen, del viernes 20 al domingo 22 de noviembre de 2026):

- Desayuno: sí, un desayuno continental está incluido en cada tarifa de habitación, servido de 7:00 a 10:00 AM en el Great Room [P1].

Lamentamos no poder recibir a su gato. Si desea, puede contactarnos para cualquier otra consulta sobre su estancia.

Saludos cordiales,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Warm regards,

Hello Laura,

Unfortunately, dogs at the Beach Resort are welcome only up to 40 lbs, so a 60 lb Labrador is not permitted. Dogs are also not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant. Service animals are always welcome with no fee. [P1]

If you'd like to check dates, please send your planned arrival and departure days and we will check availability for you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Thank you for your email. Here are the answers for booking BR-1042:

2. Late checkout: Late checkout on weekends is capped at 12:00 PM for all guests, but Monday is not a weekend day [P7]. As a Gold member, you are eligible for 2:00 PM checkout, subject to availability [P8][P6]. Our front desk will confirm availability with you.

3. MIA pickup: Our sedan service from MIA costs $65 one way for up to 3 guests and must be booked at least 24 hours in advance [P11]. We have sent your request to our team for a 2:15 PM landing on Friday, and they will confirm the booking and details with you.

A manager will not be needed for these requests, and our team will follow up shortly.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort"

Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you on 13 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with a maximum of two dogs per room, of any size. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Dog beds and bowls are available on request.

Early check-in: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P8]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and cannot be guaranteed in advance [P6]. We have asked our front desk to check whether your cabin can be ready around noon. Where early check-in is possible, a $25 fee applies. The team will confirm.

Airport shuttle: Our shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way, runs hourly on the hour from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. We have passed your request for three guests landing around 11:00 AM on Friday to our concierge team, who will confirm the booking and total with you. Please send your flight number if you have it.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Our records show a Silver tier on your booking, not Platinum, so I can't offer 2:00 PM. Tier benefits can only be applied after we verify your member number [P8]. If you believe your tier is recorded incorrectly, please send your Guest Rewards member number and the team will check it.

Late check-out is always subject to availability [P3]. I've noted your request, and the team will confirm what's possible for Sunday.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

final_text:
Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out. Unfortunately, our dogs policy allows dogs up to 40 lbs, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room, so a 60 lb Labrador is not able to stay at the Beach Resort [P1]. Service animals are always welcome with no fee [P1].

Parking is valet only, at $45 per night with in/out privileges. There are two EV charging spots, first come first served [P6].

Yes, there is a resort fee of $35 per night plus tax. It includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P3].

If you'd like, we can check availability for your December dates at the Beach Resort. Just send us your preferred check-in and check-out dates.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Tenga en cuenta que los fines de semana la salida tardía está limitada a las 12:00 PM [P2], por lo que esta opción aplica al lunes.

Dear Sarah,

Thank you for your email. I can see your booking BR-1047 (Standard King, Room 203, check-out Sun 15 Nov 2026).

Late check-out is always subject to availability [P1]. Because of high weekend occupancy, check-out on Sundays at the Beach Resort is capped at 12:00 PM for all guests, including Silver members, so a later time isn't possible [P2]. Standard check-out is 11:00 AM [P5], so a 12:00 PM check-out would be the latest available on Sunday, subject to availability.

I've passed your request to our front desk team, who will confirm whether a 12:00 PM check-out can be arranged for your stay.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Hi Elena,

Thank you for your questions about booking BR-1042 (Fri 6 Nov to Mon 9 Nov).

1. Biscuit: Dogs are welcome up to 40 lbs, so a 30 lb dog is fine. The pet fee is $75 per stay and is non-refundable [P1]. Dogs are not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1]. Up to 2 dogs per room are permitted [P1].

2. Late check-out: Monday is not a weekend day, so the weekend cap does not apply [P6]. Gold members normally receive late check-out until 2:00 PM, subject to availability [P7], [P3]. I have asked our front desk to confirm your Gold membership and availability for Monday. A manager will not be needed for this; the team will confirm.

3. MIA pickup: We can arrange a sedan for up to 3 guests at $65 one way. Transfers must be booked at least 24 hours in advance [P10]. I have asked our concierge team to book this for Friday afternoon, based on your 2:15 PM landing. They will confirm the booking and pickup time with you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

final_text:
Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you on 13 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs of any size per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Your two dogs are within this limit.

Early check-in: Our standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and is never guaranteed at booking [P6]. I have asked our front desk to check whether your cabin can be ready around noon, and they will confirm with you.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way and runs hourly from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Bookings must be made at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. I have sent a request for three guests arriving at 11:00 AM on Friday. Please send your flight number so the team can confirm the pickup, and they will confirm the booking with you.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

text:
Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you on 13 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs of any size per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Your two dogs are within this limit.

Early check-in: Our standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and is never guaranteed at booking [P6]. I have asked our front desk to check whether your cabin can be ready around noon, and they will confirm with you.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way and runs hourly from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Bookings must be made at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. I have sent a request for three guests arriving at 11:00 AM on Friday. Please send your flight number so the team can confirm the pickup, and they will confirm the booking with you.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Our records show a Silver tier on your booking for Room 206 (Fri 6 to Sun 8 Nov 2026), not Platinum. If you believe your tier is incorrect, please reply with your membership details and our team will check. I've also passed your request for a later check-out to our front desk, who will confirm whether a 12:00 PM check-out is available and any applicable fee. A manager will review your request and reply.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

final_text:
Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out about your December trip.

Pets: Dogs are welcome up to 40 lbs, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room [P1]. Unfortunately, a 60 lb Labrador is above that limit, so we are not able to accommodate him at the Beach Resort. Dogs are also not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1]. Service animals are always welcome with no fee [P1].

Parking: Parking is valet only, at $45 per night with in/out privileges [P6].

Resort fee: Yes, the resort fee is $35 per night plus tax. It includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P3].

If you would like to check dates for your stay, please share your preferred check-in and check-out dates and we will check availability for you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out about your December trip.

Pets: Dogs are welcome up to 40 lbs, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room [P1]. Unfortunately, a 60 lb Labrador is above that limit, so we are not able to accommodate him at the Beach Resort. Dogs are also not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1]. Service animals are always welcome with no fee [P1].

Parking: Parking is valet only, at $45 per night with in/out privileges [P6].

Resort fee: Yes, the resort fee is $35 per night plus tax. It includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P3].

If you would like to check dates for your stay, please share your preferred check-in and check-out dates and we will check availability for you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Dear Mr. Park,

As a Platinum member, you can check in from 1:00 PM at no charge, subject to availability [P1]. Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P6].

Our front desk will check whether your Suite (Room 401) can be ready earlier on Friday 13 November. If your flight lands before then, our front desk stores luggage free of charge before check-in, so you can leave your bags while you wait [P7].

A manager will review your request and reply to you. Your booking (BR-1088) is confirmed for Fri 13 to Mon 16 November.

Guest Services, Beach Resort

Thank you for your email. Your upcoming stay (booking ML-2034) is at our Mountain Lodge property, not the Beach Resort, so here is the information for Mountain Lodge.

Parking at Mountain Lodge is free self-parking [P1]. RVs and trailers must use the overflow lot, and the front desk can give you directions if needed.

Our policy documents don't specify whether valet service is offered, so the team will confirm that for you directly.

We look forward to welcoming you on 27 November.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort
